Introduction

The Partner Growth Task Center (Partner - TTSPC) is an exclusive task management platform for partner users. Its entrance is located on the homepage of the "Growth Center" within the Partner Center, divided into two modules: "Task" and "Growth Task". This center is only accessible to partner roles (Seller Service- TSP/ Creator Service*- CAP*/ Creator Matchmaking- TAP) logging in through main accounts or authorized sub-accounts.

What Are the Benefits?

Centralized task hub in Partner Center enables easy access to policies and tasks, paired with real-time progress tracking and self-service. Gain a partner conversion rate and an expanded base of high-quality partners to strengthen its ecosystem, increase total agency GMV and form a scalable, modular framework that supports future expansion.

Step by Step Guide

How to check your tasks?

Entrance:

  • Partner Center - Growth Center - Home Page - Task
  • Partner Center - Growth Center - Growth Center - Growth Task

Permission Control:

  • Partner roles only (Seller Service- TSP/ Creator Service- CAP/ Creator Matchmaking- TAP)
  • Login via main accounts/authorized sub-accounts.
